image_description: Two translucent teal plastic disposable lighters standing upright against a white background with faint, blurry text artifacts. The lighter on the left shows a side profile with the spark wheel and guard visible. The lighter on the right is angled slightly differently, showing the front/top nozzle area. Both appear to be standard Bic-style disposable lighters.

artifact_observations.location: Background, primarily right side and bottom left
artifact_observations.reasoning: There are faint, ghost-like shapes in the white background that resemble distorted letters or logos (e.g., 'do', 'o'). They are out of focus and nonsensical, indicating AI generation artifacts in the background texture.

The internal refraction and transparency effects are slightly inconsistent. The way light passes through the plastic lacks the precise caustic patterns expected in real photography, appearing somewhat 'smudged' or overly smooth.

artifact_observations.location: Top nozzle area of the right lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal hood/guard on the right lighter appears slightly fused or less defined than the left one, lacking sharp edges typical of stamped metal parts.
